description: Audit a public HTTPS API for AI-agent discoverability and payability: score 0-100, grade, checks[] (openapi, descriptions, llms_txt, x402_discovery, prices_visible, a2a_agent_card, mcp_card, robots_allows) and fixes[]. Add peer=<another API> to compare both check by check: comparison {score_gap, behind_on[], ahead_on[], fix_first[]}. $0.005/call. Use to audit whether a public API can be found and paid for by AI agents (OpenAPI, llms.txt, x402, A2A, MCP) and what to fix.

peer.description: optional competitor API to compare against, e.g. https://competitor.example

name: agent_readiness
title: Agent readiness audit
